title.narrative: LEBANON- PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION REFORM & DIGITALIZATION PROJECT (L-PARD)

description.narrative: L-PARDP is positioned to re-activate core government functions and public services, and support key decision-making and reform processes while transforming Lebanons Public Sector into a digitally integrated, paperless, efficient, and user-centric future, by linking conventional public administration and civil service reforms with targeted digitalization investments; which builds on the ongoing digital identify process. The program is designed across two phases, with Phase 1 (12 months) focus on reactivating and sustaining core government functions, supporting decision-making and reform processes while developing, in parallel, a unified Public Administrative Reform (PAR)/Digitalization Vision, establishing a Guiding Coalition and Change Management capabilities, establishing Digital Service Delivery Models (DSDMs), accelerating enabling reforms and ensuring delivery of basic government services, considered as quick (and early) wins. Phase 2 (36 months) will focus on establishing Priority Reform and Digitalization Unit in the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO), or in any delegated authority, rolling out Wave I DSDM Priority Road Maps (first generation reforms) and Wave II DSDMs Priority Road Maps (second generation reforms), undertaking Wave III Sub-National Reforms and in the process, assessing Machinery of Government / Functional Reforms based on a right-sizing and right-financing approach.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
